command:
cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set -e \
  && echo '=== verify-codegen.sh source ===' \
  && cat scripts/verify-codegen.sh \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== current state: release.* in eventCatalog.ts ===' \
  && grep -c 'release\.' apps/web/src/generated/eventCatalog.ts \
  && echo '=== current state: release.* in event_catalog.rs ===' \
  && grep -c 'release\.' apps/local-bridge/src/generated/event_catalog.rs \
  && echo '=== re-run codegen ===' \
  && node scripts/codegen-event-catalog.mjs 2>&1 | tail -5 \
  && echo '=== verify-codegen RUN with full output ===' \
  && bash scripts/verify-codegen.sh 2>&1 | tail -40 \
  && echo '=== EXIT CODE OF verify-codegen ===' \
  && bash scripts/verify-codegen.sh > /dev/null 2>&1 ; echo "exit=$?"
